comments.body:
Hi @justyneross, thank you for the ticket.

We need more info before we can proceed because the proposed label creates a scope issue. There is currently a term [MONDO:0011612 'glycine encephalopathy'](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/mondo/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FMONDO_0011612), and your term appears to be specific and may fit better as a child under this term.

Please clarify the concept you intend to represent- a syndrome as MONDO:0957382 or specific to glycine encephalopathy as MONDO:0011612. 

Thanks.

title: GCSH-related glycine encephalopathy
